question: Analyze the soccer match dataset to determine the champion team for each season across all countries and leagues, awarding 3 points for every win, 1 point for every tie, and 0 points for every loss. For each season, return the champion’s team name, the league, the country, and the total points accumulated.
sql:
WITH match_points AS (
    SELECT 
        m.country_id,
        m.league_id,
        m.season,
        m.home_team_api_id AS team_api_id,
        CASE WHEN m.home_team_goal > m.away_team_goal THEN 3 WHEN m.home_team_goal = m.away_team_goal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS points
    FROM Match m
    WHERE m.season IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        m.country_id,
        m.league_id,
        m.season,
        m.away_team_api_id AS team_api_id,
        CASE WHEN m.away_team_goal > m.home_team_goal THEN 3 WHEN m.away_team_goal = m.home_team_goal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS points
    FROM Match m
    WHERE m.season IS NOT NULL
),
team_points AS (
    SELECT 
        country_id,
        league_id,
        season,
        team_api_id,
        SUM(points) AS total_points
    FROM match_points
    GROUP BY country_id, league_id, season, team_api_id
),
ranked_teams AS (
    SELECT 
        country_id,
        league_id,
        season,
        team_api_id,
        total_points,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY country_id, league_id, season ORDER BY total_points DESC) AS rank
    FROM team_points
)
SELECT 
    t.team_long_name AS team_name,
    l.name AS league,
    c.name AS country,
    rt.total_points
FROM ranked_teams rt
JOIN Team t ON rt.team_api_id = t.team_api_id
JOIN League l ON rt.league_id = l.id
JOIN Country c ON rt.country_id = c.id
WHERE rt.rank = 1
ORDER BY rt.season
